Glide Image Viewer - bundled FFmpeg libraries
==============================================

This folder contains unmodified shared libraries from the FFmpeg project
(https://ffmpeg.org), used by Glide only as a fallback decoder for video
overlays that Windows cannot play on its own (for example WebM/VP9, HEVC
and AV1 on PCs without the Microsoft Store video extensions).

  avcodec, avformat, avutil, swresample, swscale  (FFmpeg 9.0.2)

These libraries are licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License,
version 3 (the build enables FFmpeg's LGPLv3 components); see LICENSE.txt
in this folder. They are LGPL builds
(no GPL or non-free components) produced by the FFmpeg-Builds project:

  https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
  release autobuild-2026-10-27-18-38,
  ffmpeg-n9.0.2-36-g6882969ce9-win64-lgpl-shared-9.0.zip

Corresponding source code: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html (release
9.0.2) and https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg. Glide loads these DLLs
dynamically; you may replace them with your own compatible builds of the
same FFmpeg major versions.
